A new route still counts as progress.

Watch the show everyone’s obsessed with. A little basic fun won’t cost you your cool. Secretly, you might even love it.

That recurring dream where you’re running late and can’t find your shoes keeps coming back for a reason. Neptune is retrograde, stirring up your subconscious and dropping hints about what’s stressing you out, Pisces. Jot the details down first thing, before they evaporate. Neptune’s trine with Mars still has a little juice left, enough to fix the waking-life problem behind it.
